pokedexEntries.go: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

pokedexEntries.si: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

pokedexEntries.cr: When these dance together, their petals rub against each other, making pretty, relaxing sounds.

pokedexEntries.ru: When BELLOSSOM gets exposed to plenty of sunlight, the leaves ringing its body begin to spin around. This POKéMON’s dancing is renowned in the southern lands.

pokedexEntries.sa: A BELLOSSOM grows flowers more beautifully if it has evolved from a smelly GLOOM - the stinkier the better. At night, this POKéMON closes its petals and goes to sleep.

pokedexEntries.fr: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

pokedexEntries.lg: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

pokedexEntries.em: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.

pokedexEntries.dpp: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

pokedexEntries.sc: Due to the effects of the Sun Stone, it is now active during the daytime. It likes to dance in pools of sunlight.

pokedexEntries.vi: After it grows up, it leaves the forest it was born in to form groups with other Bellossom. It breaks into dance when it gets excited.
